description: Header file defining a wrapper class for oneDNN primitives with cache management, memory descriptor queries, and execution utilities, specifically for use with Intel's oneDNN library in a PyTorch extension.

classes.name: primitive_ext
classes.description: A wrapper class for oneDNN primitives providing memory descriptor queries, memory creation, and execution with cache support.

methods.name: query_md
methods.description: Returns a specific memory descriptor based on query type and index.

methods.name: src_desc
methods.description: Returns source memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: dst_desc
methods.description: Returns destination memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: weights_desc
methods.description: Returns weights memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: diff_src_desc
methods.description: Returns diff source memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: diff_dst_desc
methods.description: Returns diff destination memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: diff_weights_desc
methods.description: Returns diff weights memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: exec_arg_desc
methods.description: Returns execution argument memory descriptor for a given index.

methods.name: src_desc
methods.description: Returns source memory descriptor for default index.

methods.name: dst_desc
methods.description: Returns destination memory descriptor for default index.

methods.name: weights_desc
methods.description: Returns weights memory descriptor for default index.

methods.name: diff_src_desc
methods.description: Returns diff source memory descriptor for default index.

methods.name: diff_dst_desc
methods.description: Returns diff destination memory descriptor for default index.

methods.name: diff_weights_desc
methods.description: Returns diff weights memory descriptor for default index.

methods.name: workspace_desc
methods.description: Returns workspace memory descriptor.

methods.name: scratchpad_desc
methods.description: Returns scratchpad memory descriptor.

methods.name: make_memory
methods.description: Creates a memory object from a memory descriptor, engine, and handle.

methods.name: make_src
methods.description: Creates a source memory object.

methods.name: make_weight
methods.description: Creates a weight memory object.

methods.name: make_bias
methods.description: Creates a bias memory object.

methods.name: make_dst
methods.description: Creates a destination memory object.

methods.name: make_scratchpad
methods.description: Creates a scratchpad memory object.

methods.name: get_scratchpad_size
methods.description: Returns size of scratchpad memory.

methods.name: make_args
methods.description: Creates execution arguments based on argument class.

methods.name: set_attribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute for the primitive.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the primitive with given stream, engine, and handles.
